notes.text:
Save screen Ui needs improvement
1. The save select should be anywhere on the slot, add 2 bottons(icons)  to lock and delete save on upper right corner

The legend for region map needs to be collapsible
The NPC icon should have some description or diffrent icon for game system NPC (Store, Recruit, Tavern, Quest etc)
Instead of using boxes, use icons for legend instead
Consider seperating log from legend as its own pane
Use sprite for characters instead of token
Display the name of charcter on hower instead of floating text (maybe have as a menu option)
Add buildings and other assets in region instead of just the tiles and NPC/interactibles

Make the dialogue box smaller in height and width and have it be centered
Put the character name below the potrait
Break the dialogue box into 2 section - the NPC dialouge on Top and the player response options beliow
The character and NPC should be vsible in the screen during dialouge, by keeping them centered in screen, add walls/blocked at the region edge to provide space in the edges of the region map
The Shop menu should not overlap with dialogue bar and its ok to centre and focus on screen
Use Icons instead of text for Main Menu, Party, Journal , Stash buttons and display gold and supplies in the top right Bar, remove help text and supplies from top left bar only keep region name

Shop should show your stash and the shop together (Shop items on left, stash on right)
The player should be able to move things around by dragging and dropping things from shop to satsh to buy and from stash to shop to sell
For stacked items it should have a counter with up and down arrows with stock on the side in <X> of <Stock> format where X is canbe changed and then be dragged and added to other side for trade, open to other suggestion for selecting quantity from stack
At the bottom the total gold value of trade is calculated after all exchange and only allowed if the party gold is higher than the trade value

For shop maybe click to buy/sell is fine instead of drag and drop
Have 3 columns for shop (left), trade (middle) and stash (right)
Should have +5 and +10 buttons to allow buying/selling multiples in one click
Trade should have 2 columsn for Item bought (X), gold value (-ve for buy, +ve for sell), at bottom should have trade value to and confirming the trade requires enough gold, the items are coloured diffrently in trade for items bought and sold, clicking item in trade window should return it back to shop/stash
Playtest notes need better text editor with ability to move up/down and maybe copy/paste values
